label: OpenRouter
notes: Cookie-authenticated private endpoint /api/frontend/v1/private/analytics-query (no management key); one row per day × model × provider.
Provides tokens_prompt, cached_tokens, tokens_completion, reasoning_tokens and request_count.
Cost is vendor-reported (analytics-query total_usage, USD) via registry costSource:"vendor"; no price table / preset is shipped.
Missing: no cacheWrite, and BYOK spend cannot be split out. No public API — the private endpoint can change.
History is capped at 365 days (31 days when grouped by provider); the crawler slices into <=30-day windows.
